text:
elyse_cs: Quick heads up — BrightLane shows a 35% drop in daily active routes over the last 10 days, renewal in 18 days. thinking we should trigger a lightweight save play before escalation. Anyone with bandwidth to take the lead? :eyes:

marco_csm: I can take lead. Quick question — do we have product issues or just usage? I pulled logs earlier, saw spike in 429s around 3/8. Sam any infra visibility?

sam_eng: saw a brief throttling incident on the dedicated pool, mitigated by autoscale; no persisted errors afterward. No feature flags flipped. Could be onboarding gap after recent schema change.

katie_success_mgr: Customer reported trouble mapping new webhooks to our embedding endpoint. They got partial data; asked for docs. Sent follow-up tutorial last week but haven't seen uptake.

elyse_cs: Ok — so combo of infra blip + onboarding friction. Proposed plan:
- Marco to schedule 20-min coaching session w/ BrightLane CSM + SE this week (pin: 2 options Tues/Thu)
- Sam to confirm no regressions and provide short statement about 429s we can share
- Katie to send a concise checklist + 2 annotated screenshots for webhook mapping
- Offer a one-time migration assistance (1 hour) and a 10% discount if they commit to a renewal within 30 days

marco_csm: I can propose Tue 10am or Thu 3pm. Will draft the email now. Want to include a "quick health checklist" — Elyse, can you paste the standard checklist snippet?

elyse_cs: pasted below:
-----
- Confirm API keys & roles
- Validate webhook event types (schema v2)
- Test sample payloads via Postman
- Verify prefix caching enabled
- Confirm token rotation window
-----

sam_eng: Statement for email:
"We observed transient rate limiting during the timeframe you reported due to autoscaling thresholds being reached. We put mitigations in place and haven't seen further 429s. We'll proactively monitor your namespace and can bump capacity for the session if needed."
Feel free to shorten.

katie_success_mgr: I'll convert Elyse checklist into 3-step play (one-pager) and attach annotated screenshots. Also propose recording the session and sending follow-up summary.

elyse_cs: Great. Marco, can you add a note in the renewal pipeline that this is on a 'rescue' trajectory with a committed coaching session? Use label: rescue-engagement. Also tag legal for discount approval if they accept.

marco_csm: Added label, pinged @legal-team. Drafted email — sharing thread snippet:
"Hi Jamie — noticed a drop in your syncs. Can we do a 20-min working session to walk through webhook mapping and confirm steady state? Proposed slots: Tues 10am or Thu 3pm. We'll also include an SE and provide 1hr hands-on assist. —Marco"
Anyone want to tweak?

sam_eng: LGTM. Add "we'll monitor namespace for 48h post-session."

katie_success_mgr: Suggest add brief ROI note: "reduce failed syncs and token churn -> expected 20% fewer missed events." Helps with urgency.

ops-bot: Reminder: add 'rescue-engagement' tag to account in CRM — done.

elyse_cs: Perfect. Action owners: Marco (lead/outreach), Katie (one-pager + screenshots), Sam (engineering blurb & monitoring), Elyse (discount escalation + playbook update). I'll follow up after session. :shipit:
